newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes on 19-month low at 14.31 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes on 19-month low at 14.31 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell to a fresh 19-month low, closing at 14.31 ringgit ($5.67) a kg, after following a sharp overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The market was just following the LME. There were no other visible reasons," said a trader. Dealers said the previous 19-month low was seen at 14.29 ringgit on May 23 last year.
Offers overwhelmed bids by 126 tonnes to 62 on Tuesday. Turnover was 105 tonnes against 81 previously. The local premium against London widened to $140 from $125, traders said.
